_meta.detector: ZeroGPT free web checker (zerogpt.com), run twice per sample; both runs identical
_meta.detector_api_note: The ZeroGPT business API was tested first: the documented legacy endpoint POST /v1/detect returns 404 on the live server and the funded-key POST /api/detect/detectText returned 403 'Please make a purchase before accessing this resource', so the public site UI was used instead.
_meta.model: openai/gpt-oss-120b (Groq), temperature 1.3, same settings for both prompts
_meta.prompt_old: 旧版中文指令：『翻译为{lang}，去掉 AI 味道，拟人化改写，只输出结果：』
_meta.prompt_new: 新版英文提示：见 pipeline.js llmRewrite() —— human-style rewrite prompt (keep every point, varied sentence lengths, natural idiom, no AI formulas, strong voice, ±15% length)
_meta.caveat_cjk: ZeroGPT scores on the Chinese intermediate stage are not meaningful: it returned '0%' while labeling both old- and new-prompt Chinese output 'Most Likely AI/GPT generated'. English finals are the real signal.
